title: Domain-Matched Contexts on Mistral-7B
hypothesis: Replacing ISC-theory expert contexts with well-encoded technical domains (backpropagation, dynamic programming, B-tree, quicksort, attention) will produce the predicted ranking.
context_version: v2 (domain-matched: same 5 technical domains across all categories)
finding: degenerate < expert < shallow. Shallow still highest. Length confound identified: shallow mean 61 tokens, expert mean 206 tokens. SORC normalises by log(n), suppressing longer contexts.
conclusion: Length is a primary confound. Requires token-count-matched comparison.
